command: llvm-mc -triple=riscv64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0099/call.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input (LF, trailing newline): `.text` / `.option norvc` / `.L0:` / `  auipc ra, %pcrel_hi(blob)` / `  jalr ra, %pcrel_lo(.L0)(ra)`. The object bytes are `97 00 00 00 e7 80 00 00`: both fields are zero because the symbol is external, which is exactly what `emit_relocation` writes. `%pcrel_lo(.L0)` names the `auipc` label, so the low half measures from the high half's site and not from the `jalr`. This is the call idiom EC-23 describes: the base register `rs1` is an operand of the form, never something the fixup or the materializer supplies.
source: measured relocation names and targets from `llvm-readobj --relocations`; RISC-V UDB `inst/I/jalr.yaml` for the field placements
